verdict.rationale: Better Auth is self-hosted, so all auth data lives in your own database (community reports say you "own all the data"), which gives you inherent control over retention. It also documents configurable session lifetimes (expiresIn/updateAge), user-initiated session revocation, and custom API-key expiration. However, the pack contains no documented account/user-deletion API, data-purge capability, or retention policy for stored user records, so deletion control is only implied by database ownership. Missing for 10: documented user/account deletion endpoint, configurable retention or purge for user records and verification data, independent hands-on corroboration of deletion workflows.
